Package com.jpexs.decompiler.graph

Class GraphPart

java.lang.Object
com.jpexs.decompiler.graph.GraphPart
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GraphPart extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a part of a graph. Block of instructions which are executed in sequence. No jumps or branches are allowed inside a GraphPart.
Author:
JPEXS
